description: CANONICAL SOURCE — build scripts copy this into capabilities/automation.json for the automation build and REMOVE it for production builds (Tauri resolves every file in capabilities/, so its presence would fail the production build on unknown permissions). AUTOMATION ARTIFACT ONLY: embedded WDIO bridge permissions. Applied exclusively by tauri.automation.conf.json (build with --features automation-bridge). Production builds select only the default capability; this file must never leak into a distributable (testlab/release-guard.sh verifies).
